changed: An alternate dance counts as called only once you mark that slot performed. Listing a dance as an alternate no longer raises its "called ×N" count, puts it under the Called filter, adds it to its calling history or venue repeats, or makes it the evening's closer in the half stats.

Mark all performed, in the program builder and on a program's summary, no longer marks alternates, and neither does setting a program's status to Performed. When an alternate is left unmarked, the confirmation says so; mark the alternate you used yourself.
fixed: The Last called sort now follows the same rules as the "called ×N" count: it honours Require "mark performed" and Track calling history for all callers, and dates a dance by its program's event date when no slot is marked performed, instead of leaving it among the never-called dances.
Changing the default caller in Settings, or receiving a change by sync, updates Collection's "called ×N" counts straight away instead of after a restart.

changed: Calling-history queries, the Called filter and half-calling stats count an alternate slot only once it is marked performed; Program.stampDanceSlotsPerformed skips alternates. Add ProgramSlot.countsTowardCallingHistory and ProgramSlot.isBulkMarkPerformedTarget.
DanceRepository.search takes callerFilter and performedOnly, which scope the last-called sort; the sort orders by COALESCE(performed_at, event_date, updated_at).
